title: Annual Adaptive Sports & Athletic Sprint Day
summary: Celebrating movement, speed, and personal triumphs with adaptive track sprints, motor obstacle courses, and parent-child cheering relays.
detailedReport: Over 110 students across our Rathinapuri and Kuniyamuthur branches took to the athletic track to compete in sprint heats, assisted walking races, and gross motor challenges, culminating in an official medal presentation ceremony.

title: World Autism Awareness Day Community Police Drive
summary: Collaborating with Coimbatore City Police officers to distribute autism awareness pamphlets, interact with community members, and gift green tree saplings.
detailedReport: On World Autism Awareness Day, Thulir students accompanied by Dr. S. Venkatesan and special educators partnered with local police personnel at the Nappa Nagar Outpost to promote neurodiverse inclusion and acceptance in public civic spaces.

title: Unified Play Day & Sports Honor by Union Minister Dr. L. Murugan
location: RVMERI Faculty of Adapted Physical Education, Coimbatore
summary: Institutional recognition of Thulir's adaptive sports initiatives by Union Minister of State Dr. L. Murugan and Swami Tadbhasananda.
detailedReport: During the Unified Play Day & Sports Competition hosted by Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda Educational & Research Institute, Founder Dr. S. Venkatesan was formally felicitated on stage by Union Minister Dr. L. Murugan for exemplary contributions to paediatric physical rehabilitation.

title: INQ-Fest Talentia 2024 Interschool Champions
summary: Thulir students clinching the overall championship trophy in stage dance, singing, and creative arts at the state-level interschool fest.
detailedReport: Competing against prominent special schools across the region, Thulir's student contingent delivered stellar group dance and musical performances, earning top podium finishes and lifting the coveted championship trophy.

title: Kovai Marathon Inclusive Run & Victory Felicitation
summary: Participation in the Kovai Marathon community inclusion run, promoting cardiovascular health and community visibility for neurodiverse youth.
detailedReport: Our students and faculty took part in the community run followed by a celebration at Decathlon, where each child was honored with finisher medals and certificates of athletic achievement.

title: Children's Day Park Carnival with Mascot Dance & Outdoor Fun
summary: An unforgettable Children's Day celebration featuring a live dancing Mickey Mouse mascot, outdoor music, seesaws, and gift distribution.
detailedReport: To celebrate Children's Day, Thulir organized an outdoor carnival where students enjoyed sensory play on grass lawns, musical freeze dances with a Mickey Mouse mascot, and shared delicious treats with educators and families.

title: Coimbatore Double-Decker Bus Sightseeing & Community Transit Outing
summary: An exciting double-decker open-roof bus ride introducing students to public transportation routines and landmark sightseeing across Coimbatore.
detailedReport: Partnering with community supporters, Thulir hosted an exclusive double-decker city transit tour. Students rode on the open upper deck, taking in city sights, practicing public boarding etiquette, and enjoying community immersion.

title: Educational Railway Journey & Trichy Landmark Field Trip
summary: An intercity rail transit experience teaching platform ticketing, train boarding, and cooperative group travel between Coimbatore and Trichy.
detailedReport: Students and educators dressed in matching traditional attire undertook a train excursion to Trichy Junction, navigating railway platforms, reading passenger boards, and posing proudly before the 'I Love Trichy' city monument.

title: Traditional Pongal Harvest Festival & Community Feast
summary: Cooking sweet pongal in brass and earthen pots over open wood fires, singing Tamil folk harvest songs, and celebrating heritage.
detailedReport: The campus was transformed with colorful flower rangolis, sugarcane stalks, and ceremonial mud pots as families and educators gathered to celebrate the Tamil harvest festival with joy and community solidarity.

title: Diwali Festival of Lights & Evening Sparklers Celebration
summary: An evening celebration with safety-guided sparkler lighting, festive sweet sharing, and sensory visual illumination for our children.
detailedReport: Educators guided children through fire-safety etiquette, hand-held sparklers, and clay diya decoration, turning the campus into a sparkling field of wonder and collective happiness.

title: 78th Independence Day Celebrations & Patriotic Map Painting
summary: Flag hoisting, patriotic role-play as national leaders, and cooperative tricolor finger-dab painting of the Indian subcontinent.
detailedReport: Children dressed as Mahatma Gandhi and Subramania Bharati led the patriotic assembly, followed by the unveiling of a collaborative 5-foot national map painted with sensory finger textures by students across age groups.

title: Children Traffic Park Road Safety & Pedestrian Readiness Training
summary: Hands-on road crossing routines, traffic signal identification, and pedestrian sidewalk etiquette guided by traffic enforcement officers.
detailedReport: Students walked scaled pedestrian road networks, learned to look both ways at zebra crossings, and mastered auditory and visual signal response, reinforcing vital independent living skills.

title: Isha Adiyogi & Velliangiri Foothills Nature Sensory Field Trip
location: Isha Yoga Complex & Velliangiri Foothills, Coimbatore
summary: A grand community outing beneath the Western Ghats hills, promoting sensory regulation, open-field walking, and tranquil nature exploration.
detailedReport: Over 150 students, caregivers, and staff traveled by chartered buses to the Adiyogi landmark, followed by a picnic lunch and tactile nature observation along the lush foothills of Coimbatore.

title: Breaking Barriers ABLEity Interschool Inclusion Summit
location: Kumaraguru College of Technology Campus, Coimbatore
summary: Partnering with Radio Mirchi and Kumaraguru Institutions for an intercollegiate symposium and inclusive talent showcase.
detailedReport: Thulir educators and students participated in panel discussions, adaptive art demonstrations, and talent showcases aimed at sensitizing university students and the public to neurodiverse abilities.

title: Vijay TV Super Singer Junior 10 Audition Participation
summary: Fostering inclusive musical talents on mainstream broadcast stages at the Vijay TV Super Singer Junior auditions.
detailedReport: Encouraged by our music therapists, student singers from Thulir participated in the preliminary audition rounds of Super Singer Junior 10, demonstrating melodic confidence and stage composure before television adjudicators.

title: Thulir Interactive Science & Sensory Learning Exhibition
summary: Student-led interactive stations featuring tactile shape sorters, sensory water circuits, and color-gradient physics games.
detailedReport: Students wore their school ID badges and acted as exhibition guides, explaining hands-on science concepts and demonstrating sensory learning apparatus to visiting parents and community well-wishers.
